verdict.rationale: Paxos documents rule-based orchestrations that run automatically when a bank transfer arrives, converting fiat to stablecoin and transferring it ([paxos-docs-41], [paxos-docs-8]); redeem orchestrations ([paxos-docs-9]) and automatic stablecoin-to-fiat conversion for payments ([paxos-docs-13]) are similar. Beyond these predefined flows, event handling means webhooks to the user's own endpoints ([paxos-docs-16], [paxos-docs-17], [paxos-docs-26]), so any custom rule logic must be built externally. Missing for 10: a general-purpose rule engine with user-defined conditions and actions across event types, detailed docs on configuring orchestration rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
